titleEn: Minimum Amount of Time to Collect Garbage
title: 收集垃圾的最少总时间
summary: 三辆垃圾车分别收集 M、P、G，收取每件一分钟且行驶时间按道路累加，求完成全部收集的总时间。
insight: 所有垃圾字符都必须收取，贡献总字符数。每辆车只需行驶到该类型最后出现的房屋，用 travel 前缀和加三种最后位置即可。
pitfalls: 三辆车不能同时工作但总时间直接相加
没有某类垃圾时其行驶时间为零
travel[i] 连接房屋 i 与 i+1

solutions.title: 各类型末房屋与路程前缀
solutions.idea: 收集时间加三辆车各自最远路程。
steps: 扫描 garbage 累加字符数并更新 M/P/G 最后下标

code.java: class Solution { public int garbageCollection(String[] garbage,int[] travel){int[] prefix=new int[garbage.length];for(int i=1;i<garbage.length;i++)prefix[i]=prefix[i-1]+travel[i-1];int[] last=new int[3];int answer=0;String types="MPG";for(int i=0;i<garbage.length;i++){answer+=garbage[i].length();for(char ch:garbage[i].toCharArray())last[types.indexOf(ch)]=i;}for(int index:last)answer+=prefix[index];return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun garbageCollection(garbage:Array<String>,travel:IntArray):Int{val prefix=IntArray(garbage.size);for(i in 1 until garbage.size)prefix[i]=prefix[i-1]+travel[i-1];val last=IntArray(3);var answer=0;val types="MPG";for(i in garbage.indices){answer+=garbage[i].length;for(ch in garbage[i])last[types.indexOf(ch)]=i};for(index in last)answer+=prefix[index];return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int garbageCollection(vector<string>& garbage,vector<int>& travel){vector<int> prefix(garbage.size()),last(3);for(int i=1;i<(int)garbage.size();++i)prefix[i]=prefix[i-1]+travel[i-1];int answer=0;string types="MPG";for(int i=0;i<(int)garbage.size();++i){answer+=garbage[i].size();for(char ch:garbage[i])last[types.find(ch)]=i;}for(int index:last)answer+=prefix[index];return answer;} };
